title: Peanut-Lime Chicken and Whole-Wheat Noodle Salad
intro: This incredibly simple lunch relies on a no-cook dressing and quick boiling to keep prep time short. It combines whole-wheat spaghetti, lean rotisserie chicken breast, and crisp pre-shredded cabbage slaw in a tangy peanut sauce.

ingredients.name: Skinless rotisserie chicken breast
ingredients.canonical_name: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

ingredients.name: Natural peanut butter
ingredients.canonical_name: Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

ingredients.name: Low-sodium soy sauce
ingredients.canonical_name: Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu), low sodium

instructions: Bring a medium pot of water to a rolling boil over high heat.
Add the spaghetti and cook for 10 to 12 minutes, or until tender.
Drain the pasta and rinse briefly under cold water to cool it down quickly. Transfer to a large mixing bowl.
Whisk the peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, garlic, red pepper flakes, and 1 tablespoon of warm water in a small bowl until smooth.
Add the shredded chicken, cabbage slaw mix, and sliced cucumber to the bowl with the cooled pasta.
Pour the peanut dressing over the salad and toss well to coat all the ingredients evenly.
Divide the noodle salad between two plates and serve immediately, or pack for lunch.
variation: Swap the chicken for shelled edamame to make it vegetarian.
conservation: Keeps 2-3 days refrigerated; best enjoyed cold or at room temperature.
validation_warnings: [instruction_completeness] The pasta cooking time provides a range ('10 to 12 minutes') and a doneness cue ('until tender'), but it lacks an explicit check instruction at the minimum time. Change Step 2 to: 'Add the spaghetti and cook for 10 to 12 minutes, checking at 10 minutes to see if it is tender.'
